subject: vt-u-p
title: (R)VT.U.P.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the second of three on book p169. (R)VT-U-PT — the reality of vibrational universe particulars — is crossed with POL-DYM (political dynamics). Two upstream feeds: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → VT-U-PT, and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) → VT-U-PT. The subject outputs to POL-DYM (the crossing) and to AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). POL-DYM → LANG-DY (language dynamics); LANG-DY then branches to MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) and INFO-DE-B (a diagram-only term, likely 'information determination basis') → PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies). AFL-DY → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). Structural argument: the reality of vibrational universe particulars (i.e., what the vibrational ground actually consists of in particular form) is fed by progressional continuance *and* world expansion principle — Braxton's two macro-historical engines — and outputs the politico-cultural domain through political dynamics, with language dynamics as the transmission layer that produces both meta-reality significance *and* the determination basis that grounds primary affinity tendencies. The parallel affinity-dynamics → projectional-dynamics output is the non-political channel. The diagram thus stages how reality's vibrational particulars become culturally legible: through political dynamics into language, with affinity/projection running as a separate independent track.
